assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: one square transparent inventory icon for a dark, restrained ancient Chinese fantasy exploration game.
Primary request: a compact ancient stone doorway relic representing the gate-sense cultivation method. One incomplete rectangular arch of massive worn gray stone, with a chipped lintel and two short unequal uprights on a small attached broken stone sill. The stones have sparse nearly erased incised marks, a few worn iron staples and traces of dull aged bronze. The entire doorway opening is completely empty and fully transparent, crisp clean inner stone edges with no translucent film. One very narrow hairline fissure in the upper stone has a tiny muted warm-gray glimmer, entirely contained inside the opaque stone. The stone construction is the unmistakable main subject.
Style/medium: realistic hand-painted game inventory illustration with sober rough material texture and painterly edge control, NOT a photograph or glossy 3D render. Quiet aged materials consistent with an old bronze incense holder, weathered stone courtyards and desaturated dark-fantasy relics.

Legible when displayed at 48 pixels.
Lighting/mood: soft natural top-left light, subdued and grounded. A tiny warm-gray glimmer is limited to a small crack in the upper stone. No atmospheric or translucent effects anywhere.
Color palette: low-saturation weathered slate gray and ash gray, dark old iron, tiny dull old-bronze accents; no saturated hue.
Scene/backdrop: genuine transparent alpha background, fully transparent corners and fully transparent open doorway; no landscape, no environment, no scene seen through doorway, no ground plane.
Text: none.
Constraints: one compact stone portal relic only, no figures, no furniture, no separate extra objects; the attached sill may have two large broken stone pieces only.
Avoid: fog, mist, translucent film, semi-transparent glow, chromatic fringe, rainbow pixels, circular ring portal, green or cyan vortex, colorful galaxy, swirling magic, neon rimlight, bright gold outline, heavy bloom, cartoon motifs, floating particles, scattered small rubble, neighboring icon remnants, checkerboard baked into pixels, words, letters, watermark, border.
